newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta, Australia securities regulators sign deal.
newsitem.headline: Alberta, Australia securities regulators sign deal.

text.p: The Alberta Securities Commission said on Friday it signed a memorandum of understanding with the Australian Securities Commission to provide for regulatory cooperation between the two bodies.

The memorandum is intended to enhance the protection of investors and to promote the integrity of the securities markets in Alberta and Australia, the Alberta commission said in a statement. It will enhance enforcement of requirements in such areas as insider trading, market manipulation, timely, full and fair disclosure of information to investors and the qualifications of investment advisers and other market participants, it said.
